title: Repository settings — .claude/guild/config.json (design §7.10, §7.4, §7.6, §7.11, §7.12 S8)
description: Repository knowledge the engine passes through without interpreting (§1): named run commands, toolchain-prepare commands, path rules, registry hosts, cache env, repo secret paths, worktree-prepare copies, approved sandbox exceptions, the quarantine list. Built by the conversion script (U16) / init, approved and committed by a human. A control file (§7.6): the engine reads it only from the recorded base SHA blob (§7.12 S3). No role or leader can add a command string (§7.10).

commands.description: Named commands — the only thing a `run:` step can reference. Plugin check scripts appear as {"plugin": <name>} entries (§7.10).

cmd.description: Shell command run with `srt -c` in the Issue worktree (developer's rendered boundary, §7.1). Must not modify the tree (--ci, --no-update-goldens, …; §4.4-2).

plugin.description: A plugin check script, run from the plugin install path (§7.6). The last four (stage 3) are engine-judged runs without a script (runner.py).

toolchain_prepare.description: Toolchain preparation before the first run of an engine start (§7.12 S8, P3-Z human decision 4), in order. A `sync` entry is the ONLY thing done outside the sandbox: a file copy from a trusted, read-only source (the user's SDK) into the repository's Guild cache — links are copied as links, never followed; files that differ from the source are rewritten and files the source does not have are removed, every engine start. Nothing outside the sandbox ever executes a file a role or a run can write. A `cmd` entry (e.g. `flutter precache`) runs INSIDE srt with the run boundary in the Issue worktree, like a named command; the network it needs must be in registry_hosts. Never a package manager install.

cmd.description: Shell command run with `srt -c` (the run boundary, cwd = the Issue worktree).

from.description: Source folder candidates, the first existing real folder wins (none → the prepare fails, the Issue stops). An absolute path or `{home}/…`; never inside the engine home, the Guild cache, a worktree or a temp folder (the loader / runner refuse it).

to.description: Destination inside the repository's Guild cache ({cache}/<to>).

path_rules.description: Path rule kinds (§7.4, §7.11): verification paths (tests, goldens, test config, runner wrappers, CI config, command definition files — I11 b), risk areas (→ a gate step), irreversible-change kinds (→ a handling level).

category.description: Stage 3 (E33), optional: golden / comparison-config paths feed the baseline-image ledger.

gate.description: Plugin-fixed gate step definition to require (e.g. security-review).

level.description: Override of the §7.4 default level. Lowering needs human approval (evolve).

oneOf.description: Stage 3 (E4): test source files only — no golden, snapshot or comparison config. Fills {path:test-code} of a template.
Stage 3 (E4): the naming rule of safety-net-only test files. Fills {path:safety-net} of a template.

irreversible_levels.description: Stage 3 (E22): the category's level when a path rule has none (default: defaults.IRREVERSIBLE_DEFAULT_LEVEL). A lowered level is shown in every PR it applies to (E24).

followups_dry_run.description: Stage 3 (user decision A4): true = create-followups only records what it would write (no Issue, comment or label). Absent = false = really create.

registry_hosts.description: The only network the sandbox allows (§7.6). No GitHub domain unless a human approved it for git dependencies.

cache_env.description: Cache-path env vars pointed at the repo's Guild cache (§7.6, §7.12 S8). Values may use the placeholder {cache}. Path values only — literal non-path values go to run_env.

run_env.description: Literal, non-path env vars for runs (P3-0), e.g. TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1. No placeholder, no control characters. Names: [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*, none that looks secret (TOKEN, SECRET, KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, CREDENTIAL), none the engine sets or scrubs (defaults.RUN_ENV_RESERVED / RUN_ENV_RESERVED_PREFIXES).

secret_paths.description: Repository secret paths, denied for reading in the main checkout and every worktree (§7.6). Defaults .env*, *.pem, *.p12.

worktree_prepare.description: Files copied from the main checkout into the Issue worktree (ignored generated files etc., §7.3). Copy only — no command. Control-file patterns are never copied; links are not followed (§7.12 S2, S6).

sandbox_exceptions.description: Exceptions a human approved during the base-green check (§7.10). Never the user's home toolchain/cache paths (§7.12 S8).

allow_write.description: Extra write roots for the sandbox (P3-0). Each entry is an absolute path without globs, or exactly the token {user_tmp} (macOS `getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR`, resolved by the engine — unresolvable → refused). Never a component listed in defaults.ALLOW_WRITE_FORBIDDEN_COMPONENTS (git internals, control files, home secrets); the loader also refuses the root, the home folder, its ancestors and home toolchain/cache paths (§7.12 S8).

allow_local_binding.description: Allow binding local ports (srt network.allowLocalBinding). Absent = false.

weaker_network_isolation.description: Open the macOS trust service for TLS (srt enableWeakerNetworkIsolation). Absent = false.

quarantine.description: Tests that were red before the change, registered by a human (§7.10). The commands themselves exclude them; the engine still only reads exit codes.

not_checked_locally.description: CI checks that cannot run locally (secrets, Linux-only, deploy) — listed in the PR body (§7.2-2).
